alerts.title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level Recruitment 2026 (CEN 06/2026)
alerts.qualification: Graduate degree from a recognised university
alerts.details: Railway NTPC (Non-Technical Popular Categories) Graduate Level recruitment: Station Master, Goods Guard, Senior Clerk, Traffic Assistant and similar posts. Age limit 18-33 years (category-wise relaxation applies). Selection via CBT-1, CBT-2, typing/skill test and document verification. Apply online at rrbapply.gov.in. Read your regional RRB notification carefully before applying.

alerts.title: RRB NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate Recruitment 2026 (CEN 07/2026)
alerts.details: Railway NTPC Under-Graduate level recruitment (CEN 07/2026): Junior Clerk cum Typist, Train Clerk, Commercial cum Ticket Clerk and similar posts. Age limit 18-30 years. 12th pass candidates are eligible. CBT-1 and CBT-2 exams will be held. Apply online at rrbapply.gov.in. Fee payment window closes 15 November 2026.

alerts.title: UPSSSC Combined Subordinate Services (Intermediate Level) Main Exam 2026 — 1,784 Posts
alerts.org: UPSSSC (UP Subordinate Services Selection Commission), Lucknow
alerts.details: Advertisement No. 26-Exam/2026: Intermediate level posts across various UP government departments. Notification released 16 October 2026. Only candidates who cleared PET-2025 can apply. Apply online at upsssc.gov.in between 10 November and 1 December 2026.

alerts.title: UPSSSC JE 2026 (Mechanical/Electrical) Recruitment
alerts.org: UPSSSC (UP Subordinate Services Selection Commission), Lucknow
alerts.details: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission Junior Engineer (Mechanical & Electrical) recruitment. Apply online at upsssc.gov.in. Eligibility: relevant branch diploma and PET score. Check the official notification for detailed criteria.

alerts.title: UGC NET December 2026 — JRF & Assistant Professor
alerts.qualification: Master's degree (55% marks; 50% for reserved categories)
alerts.fee: General: Rs.1150, OBC/EWS: Rs.600, SC/ST/PwD: Rs.325
alerts.details: NTA has opened applications for UGC NET December 2026 cycle. Exam qualifies candidates for JRF, Assistant Professor and PhD admission. Late-fee window 29-31 October; correction window 2-4 November. Apply online at ugcnet.nta.nic.in. Computer-based test in two shifts.

alerts.title: Indian Army TGC-145 (October 2026) — Permanent Commission
alerts.qualification: Engineering degree (relevant branch); final-year students eligible
alerts.details: Technical Graduate Course (TGC-145) at IMA Dehradun for permanent commission. Engineering graduates in notified disciplines, age 20-27 years. Aadhaar number and matric certificate mandatory. Only one online application allowed. Apply at joinindianarmy.nic.in. Selection: shortlisting, 5-day SSB interview, medical board.

alerts.title: MP ESB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026 — 1,700 Posts (Forms Reopened)
alerts.fee: MP domicile: Rs.250, Others: Rs.500 (portal charges extra)
alerts.details: Re-revised advertisement: online forms reopened for Sub Engineer recruitment (13-27 October 2026). Exam on 20 January 2027. Apply at esb.mp.gov.in. Candidates who already applied can edit their details. Detailed advertisement available on the portal.

alerts.title: DSSSB Delhi District Court Various Posts Recruitment
alerts.details: DSSSB invites online applications for various posts (clerks, assistants etc.) in Delhi District Courts. Apply at dsssb.delhi.gov.in. Check the official advertisement for post-wise eligibility and exam scheme.

alerts.title: IOCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
alerts.details: Indian Oil Corporation Limited online applications for Trade Apprentice / Technician Apprentice posts. Selection via written test/merit. Apply through the 'Latest Job Notification' section at iocl.com. Vacancies are state-wise — check your state's advertisement.

alerts.title: GSSC Recruitment — Food Safety Officer & Veterinary Assistant (32 Posts)
alerts.details: GSSC recruitment for 32 posts including Food Safety Officer (FSO) and Veterinary Assistant. Apply online. Last date 30 October 2026. Check the official advertisement for eligibility, age limit and selection process.
